items.difficulty_reason: Choose a smooth presentation V -> Y, set U = V x_Y X with f' = base change; W(P,f') exists by hypothesis (3); prove R-invariance by hypothesis (4) applied to the two smooth projections of V x_Y V; glue to the open substack X' via immersion-into-presentation and transfer maximality; part (B) by hypothesis (4) again on T = V x_Y Z ('some details omitted', mechanism named: the inverse-image identity for W(P,f'_T)).
